add_dedup_quantity: “{name}” is already on the list; quantity now {quantity}
auth_intro: There's no password here. You sign in with a passkey: your device confirms it's you, usually with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
auth_intro_oidc: Sign in with {name}. Your account is created the first time.
auth_methods_failed: Sign-in could not be loaded. Check your connection.
auth_signup_body: Pick a nickname. Only the people you share a list with will see it.
auth_already_have_account: This device is already linked to an account. Sign in with your passkey, or sign out first.
auth_no_passkey_support_body: This browser does not support passkeys.
auth_ceremony_failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
auth_passkey_unknown: This passkey no longer belongs to an account here; it may have been removed. Pick another one.
auth_register_closed: This server is not accepting new accounts. Whoever runs it can allow new accounts again.
auth_register_link_invalid: This link is no longer valid. Ask for a new one.
auth_signup_by_link: New accounts here need an invite link. Ask someone who already uses the app to share a list with you.
auth_oidc_failed: Sign-in failed. The window was closed or the provider refused.
auth_oidc_server_failed: Your provider accepted the sign-in, but this server could not complete it. The cause is in the server's OIDC setup, and its log names it.
install_body: Add it to your home screen to open it full screen in one tap. It already works offline. You can also do this later in Settings.
install_ios_1: Tap “Share”, in the bar at the bottom or in the ⋯ menu.
install_ios_2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”. If it isn't there, scroll down the list.
install_ios_signin: Then open the shopping list from the new icon and sign in there once, the same way as here.
install_android_2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to home screen”.
install_other_2: Choose “Install app”. In Safari on a Mac, choose “Add to Dock”.
install_fallback_ios: Option missing? If you opened this page in WhatsApp or another app, open it in Safari.
install_fallback_android: Option missing? If you opened this page in WhatsApp or another app, open it in Chrome.
install_fallback_other: Option missing? Not every browser can install apps. Chrome, Edge and Safari can.
demo_intro: Try the app without an account or a passkey: you get an example list to change as you like. Open a list's invite link on a second device to watch changes arrive there at once.
demo_start_note: Everything you enter here is deleted after 24 hours. Nothing about you is stored.
demo_start_failed: The demo could not start. Are you online?
demo_start_too_many: Too many new demos from this network. Try again in a few minutes.
demo_start_full: The demo is full right now. Try again later.
demo_banner: Demo: your data is deleted after 24 hours

match.countPlural=one: Demo: your data is deleted in {count} hour
match.countPlural=other: Demo: your data is deleted in {count} hours

match.countPlural=one: Demo: your data is deleted in {count} minute
match.countPlural=other: Demo: your data is deleted in {count} minutes

demo_expired: This demo has expired and its data is deleted.
demo_signout_hint: A demo account has no sign-in, so signing out deletes it, with every list nobody else is on.
demo_signout_confirm: Your demo account is deleted now, with every list nobody else is on. This cannot be undone.
banner_expired: Session expired. Sign in again to sync.
banner_stalled_body: The app is also open in another tab or window, and only one of them sends. Close it there and this tab sends your changes.
sync_failing_connection: The device is online but can't reach the server. Often it's Wi-Fi without internet.
sync_failing_server: The server isn't answering right now.
sync_failing_rate: The server is getting too many requests and is holding back.
sync_failing_kept: The app keeps trying; until then, everything stays on this device.
sync_stale_body: Your changes are synced. What others changed since may still be missing here.
sync_stale_sentence: No answer from the server · last {when}
sync_stuck_body: It hasn't tried to sync for over 20 seconds. Reloading usually fixes it, and your changes are kept.
sync_broken_other_tab_body: Another tab of the app syncs for this device, and it fails there every time. Reload that tab or close it; your changes are kept.
sync_broken_body: Something in the app went wrong on every try, so nothing is synced right now, in either direction. Reloading usually fixes it, and your changes are kept.
sync_offline_body: What you change stays on this device and goes out as soon as there is a connection again.
categories_missing_intro: Newer lists also have these categories:
categories_dnd_start: Started dragging {item}. Use the arrow keys to move it within the list {zone}
categories_dnd_moved: Moved {item} to position {position} in the list {zone}
categories_dnd_moved_end: Moved {item} to the end of the list {zone}
categories_dnd_moved_start: Moved {item} to the beginning of the list {zone}
categories_dnd_instruction: Tab to a row's handle and press Space to start dragging it
common_offline_hint: You'll need a connection for that.
common_error_connection: Couldn't reach the server. Try again.
common_error_session: Your session has expired. Sign in again, then try again.
common_error_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
error_page_body: This view could not be shown. The error has been reported.
history_readd_when: “{name}” back on the list, last bought {when}
history_empty_hint: Checked-off items land here once the shop is over: three hours after the last one.
arrange_hint: Drag by the handle, or tap it for arrows
home_online_only: You'll need a connection to create or join a list.
home_empty_body: Create your first list or join a shared one.
home_expired_body: Sign in again so your lists can load.
home_loading_offline: You're offline. Your lists will appear once you're connected.
home_loading_slow: This is taking longer than usual. The app keeps trying…
home_import_too_many_items: The file has {count} items, but an import here brings in at most {max}.
home_list_limit: You're already on {max} lists, the most this server allows. Leave one to create another.
import_paste_hint: One item per line. Share or copy the list in the other app and paste it here. Sections in [brackets] help sort the items.
import_backup_elsewhere: This is a backup from this app. It becomes a list of its own: use “Import list” in “My lists”.
import_format_json: This is JSON, but not a backup from this app. Share or copy the list in the other app as text, one item per line.
import_format_markup: This looks like HTML or XML, not a list. Share or copy the list in the other app as text, one item per line.
import_format_table: This is a table, not a list. If the other app also exports a plain list, use that; otherwise one item per line.
import_format_csv: This looks like a CSV file, not a list. Share or copy the list in the other app as text, one item per line.
import_format_yaml: This looks like YAML, not a list. Share or copy the list in the other app as text, one item per line.
import_none: No items found in this text.
import_list_room: This list can take only {room} more. Uncheck some.
import_text_cut: The text was longer than {max} characters; only the lines before that are here.
import_too_many: {count} items are selected, but a new list here holds at most {max}. Uncheck some.
home_leave_confirm_last: You are the only member of “{name}”. Leaving deletes the list and all its items, and this cannot be undone.
home_rename_prompt: The new name applies to every member.
home_clear_confirm: Forgets when items in {name} were last bought. The dates under “Previous items” and when adding disappear, checked-off items move to “Previous items”, and removed items the list only knew from a purchase are forgotten. Items on the list stay. This affects all members and cannot be undone.
list_not_found: This list isn't among your lists. It may have been deleted, or you are not a member: then you need an invite link.
scan_permission_denied: No camera access. Allow the camera in your browser settings.
scan_decode_failed: Barcodes can't be read right now. Type the name instead.
scan_camera_busy: The camera can't be opened right now. Close other apps using it, or type the name.
scan_not_found: Product not found. Type the name instead.
scan_offline_miss: Unknown code, and you're offline. Type the name instead.
scan_hint: Hold the barcode in the frame
settings_nickname_hint: This is what members of shared lists see.
settings_backup_key_nudge: Add a second passkey, so losing one device doesn't lock you out.
settings_passkey_only_login: This is the only way into your account. Add another passkey first.
settings_signout_device_unsynced: Some changes on this device have not been synced yet. If you sign out now, they are lost.
settings_link_oidc_hint: Add your {name} sign-in to this account. Your lists and passkeys stay as they are.
settings_link_oidc_failed: Connecting failed. The window was closed or the provider refused.
settings_link_oidc_in_use: This sign-in already belongs to another account with its own lists. Sign in with it there, or share lists between the two accounts with an invite.
settings_unlink_oidc_confirm: You'll sign in with your passkey from now on. Signing in with {name} afterwards creates a separate, empty account.
settings_unlink_oidc_needs_passkey: Add a passkey first. Without one, you couldn't sign in anymore.
reauth_oidc_not_linked: Your {name} sign-in is no longer connected to this account. Sign in with your passkey.
reauth_wrong_account: That's a different account. Sign in to the account this device was using, or sign out first.
settings_logout_everywhere_confirm: You'll be signed out on every device, this one included, and sign in again on each. Your lists are kept.
settings_logout_everywhere_confirm_unsyn: You'll be signed out on every device, this one included. Some changes on this device have not been synced yet; they are lost.
settings_hidden_suggestions_save_failed: Your hidden suggestions could not be saved.

match.countPlural=one: Your shared list stays with its members.
match.countPlural=other: Your {count} shared lists stay with their members.

match.countPlural=one: Your own list is permanently deleted.
match.countPlural=other: Your {count} own lists are permanently deleted.

settings_delete_account_no_lists: You're not in any list. Only your account is deleted.
settings_delete_account_not_signed_in: Sign-in canceled. Your account was not deleted.
settings_install_body: One tap from your home screen, offline too.
settings_install_done: Installed. From now on, open the shopping list from its icon on your home screen.
share_reset_done: New link created. The old one no longer works.
share_link_stops_confirm: The current link then stops working, also for anyone it was already sent to who has not joined yet. Members stay members.
share_revoke_done: Link revoked. Nobody can join with it anymore.
share_no_link: This list has no invite link right now.
share_link_unavailable: This link comes from an older version of the app and cannot be shown here. A new link replaces it for everyone.
share_join_invalid: This invite is invalid, expired, or revoked.
share_join_failed: That didn't work just now. Check your connection and try again.
share_join_needs_account: You need an account to join.
share_join_session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to join.
sync_conflict_deleted: “{name}” was removed while you were editing it.
sync_conflict_merged: “{name}” was already on the list. Kept {who}'s quantity “{theirs}”.
sync_list_gone: “{name}” is no longer among your lists.
sync_list_gone_unknown: A list is no longer among your lists.
sync_denied_too_long: Couldn't save {field}: too long. Your change was undone.
sync_denied_protected: “Other” can't be hidden. Your change was undone.
sync_denied_list_full: This list is full, so the item wasn't added. Duplicate the list to start over without its removed items.
sync_denied_categories_full: This list has too many categories, so the category wasn't added. Duplicate the list to start over without its hidden categories.
sync_denied_generic: A change couldn't be synced and was undone.
